methodology.note: Grades are based on 2026 preseason projections and ADP, not actual season results (the season hasn't happened yet). Starters/bench reflect each manager's best possible lineup (highest-projected players by slot eligibility - 1 QB, 2 RB, 2 WR, 1 TE, 1 TE/WR flex, 1 FLEX, 1 HC), not ESPN's live roster or draft order. Overall grade = percentile blend of starting-lineup points (55%, the heaviest signal), bench points (15%), ADP-reach value (15%), and VBD upside (15%).
